title: RepoPilot AI: Intelligent Multi-Agent Codebase RAG Engine
tagline: Deep semantic search, automatic architectural diagramming, and test suite generation for local repositories using localized embeddings.

problemStatement.overview: Developers onboarding onto large, legacy repositories spend up to 40% of their time reading documentation and tracing function paths rather than writing code. RepoPilot AI indexes codebase repositories locally and coordinates a team of specialized AI agents to answer complex architectural questions, construct Mermaid UML diagrams, and auto-write integration test specs.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Software Engineers, Technical Architects, Dev Teams onboarding remote engineers
userPersonas: Junior Engineer seeking clarification on internal utility usage without disturbing senior peers.
Lead Architect validating structural dependencies and design patterns.

systemArchitecture.narrative: A client-server application where a background worker indexes files, extracts syntax trees, creates semantic embeddings, and stores them in ChromaDB. When a query arrives, a Master Router Agent splits the task between an Explainer Agent (handles codebase logic) and a Diagrammer Agent (constructs Mermaid flows).
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Codebase Upload -> AST Parser (Babel/Esprima) -> Embedding Pipeline (SentenceTransformers) -> Vector Database (ChromaDB) -> Prompt context -> LLM Agent Router -> Agent Execution -> Output.

core: Automatic Codebase Parsing: AST traversal for Python, TypeScript, and Go.
Semantic Vector Search: Multi-threaded directory scanner with incremental change detection.
Interactive Visual Diagrams: Render interactive visual UML flows using Mermaid.js.
advanced: Agentic Code Correction: Multi-agent execution utilizing self-refinement loops to rewrite buggy modules.
Local Sandboxed Execution: Safely runs suggested unit tests in an isolated Docker container.

title: FinSight: Multi-Modal RAG Platform for Financial Earnings Call Analysis
tagline: Extracts semantic insights and structured tables from earnings call audio and transcripts using hybrid search vectors.

problemStatement.overview: Financial analysts spend hours listening to transcripts to look for business trends. FinSight parses earnings PDFs and audios, indexes them with cross-attention tables, and lets analysts query semantic information.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Equity Researchers, Investment Analysts, Venture Capitalists
userPersonas: Buy-side Analyst looking for YoY revenue trends
SRE engineer checking cloud costs data

systemArchitecture.narrative: Whisper extracts audio. Text chunker indexes documents into Postgres pgvector. Queries search semantic text and raw structured database metrics.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Upload Audio -> Whisper API -> Text Chunks -> PGVector Indexing -> User RAG Query -> LLM Summary output.

resumeBullets: Developed an automated equity analysis engine implementing PGVector and Whisper audio transcribing.

title: MediShield: Secure Privacy-Preserving Health RAG Pipeline
tagline: RAG query engine over EHR data using local anonymization proxy engines and zero-knowledge queries.

problemStatement.overview: Healthcare entities cannot send EHR records to public LLMs due to HIPAA rules. MediShield strips all PII before indexing, and operates purely on an offline sandboxed server.

systemArchitecture.narrative: Incoming files pass through Microsoft Presidio proxy. Tokens anonymize personal names. Queries use Milvus vector index on the localized nodes.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: EHR Input -> Presidio Anonymizer -> Encrypted Tokens -> Milvus Vector Store -> local Ollama query -> De-anonymized display.

resumeBullets: Architected HIPAA-compliant RAG pipeline processing 10k+ patient EHR files securely.

title: QuerySage: Automated SQL schema blueprint and RAG Assistant
tagline: Translates natural language questions to database queries using schema definitions context.

problemStatement.overview: Non-technical users cannot query SQL databases. QuerySage reads DB schemas and translates questions to optimized SQL statements.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Product Managers, Sales representatives, Data entry staff
userPersonas: Sales lead finding client signups in July

systemArchitecture.narrative: Extracts SQLite metadata. Maps relationships and tables. Builds contextual prompt for LLM translating to raw SQL.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: User question -> Schema extractor -> Prompt context -> LLM SQL generator -> Executer query -> Results visualizer.

resumeBullets: Created an automated text-to-SQL translation router using LlamaIndex and FastAPI.

title: DocuVerify: Cross-Document Consistency Auditor and Fact Checker
tagline: Identifies contradictions, missing dependencies, and inconsistencies across large document libraries using graph RAG.

problemStatement.overview: Compliance contracts and engineering guidelines often contradict each other, leading to execution failures. DocuVerify maps cross-document entity networks into Neo4j.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Quality Assurance teams, Legal departments, Systems engineers
userPersonas: QA Lead auditing ISO requirements documents
Legal review partner auditing vendor contracts

systemArchitecture.narrative: Extracts entity triples (subject, predicate, object) from texts. Indexes nodes in Neo4j database graph. Triggers search patterns.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Document upload -> Triple extractor -> Graph database write -> Graph RAG traversal query -> Conflict analyzer alert.

resumeBullets: Engineered a graph-based RAG consistency scanner utilizing Neo4j to audit 500+ compliance procedures.

title: LawPilot: Intelligent Contract Negotiation and RAG Advisor
tagline: Audits corporate leases and legal vendor agreements, suggesting revisions and identifying hidden risks.

problemStatement.overview: Small businesses sign complex lease contracts containing indemnification clauses. LawPilot highlights anomalous clauses compared to regulatory compliance indexes.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Small business owners, legal advisors, startup operations managers
userPersonas: Startup founder review co-working lease agreement

systemArchitecture.narrative: Vectorizes contract clauses. Compares against legal templates in Pinecone. Highlights risk clauses with AI explanations.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Contract PDF -> OCR Parser -> Segment Clauses -> Semantic Vector comparison -> Compliance Risk Score report.

resumeBullets: Built a legal contract clause analyzer using FastAPI, OCR text ingestion, and Pinecone vectors.

title: CodeCraft AI: Multi-Agent Software Engineering Scaffold Simulator
tagline: Autonomous code architecture generator that designs database models and writes full scaffolding files.

problemStatement.overview: Software boilerplate generation consumes hours of engineering setup. CodeCraft AI reads user schemas and coordinates writing complete, verified project code structures.
problemStatement.targetAudience: SaaS developers, software agencies, hackathon competitors
userPersonas: Fullstack dev needing quick boilerplate API structures

systemArchitecture.narrative: A team of Go agents coordinate tasks. The Architect Agent writes schemas, the Coder Agent compiles functions, the QA Agent runs test loops.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Feature prompt -> Architect Agent -> Schema structure -> Coder Agent -> Code files -> Docker test run -> Output Zip.

resumeBullets: Engineered a multi-agent backend compiler generating production-ready scaffolds in Go.

title: RetailBuddy: Context-Aware Retail Conversational Agent
tagline: RAG-powered conversational engine integrated with Shopify stores to handle support queries and recommend products.

problemStatement.overview: Retail support tickets are costly. RetailBuddy indexes store inventories and helps users search, verify order status, and complete refunds.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Shopify merchants, e-commerce stores, retail brands

systemArchitecture.narrative: Webhooks feed inventory to Qdrant. The bot checks stock and processes user returns via secure store APIs.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Chat query -> Shopify Webhook check -> Qdrant vector similarity search -> Product recommendation output.

resumeBullets: Developed a Shopify RAG bot utilizing Qdrant vector stores, reducing support ticket volume by 30%.

title: BioSearch: Medical Literature Vector Graph Search Assistant
tagline: Semantic search engine over PubMed databases extracting drug interactions and clinical trial links.

problemStatement.overview: Researching clinical journals is slow. BioSearch maps document topics to Weaviate vector databases and Neo4j citation relationship networks.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Medical researchers, pharmacologists, clinical trial managers

systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Ingest articles -> Abstract vectors (Weaviate) -> Citations map (Neo4j) -> Hybrid graph-vector search.

resumeBullets: Architected medical vector search indexing Weaviate and Neo4j graph databases for citation extraction.

systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Upload Textbook -> Chroma indexing -> Class profile input -> Syllabus generator output -> Quiz maker sheets.

resumeBullets: Built a Next.js RAG study blueprint compiler utilizing ChromaDB vector catalogs.
